about: Forty requests a user types to MendCode. For each: `words` are the plain English words a model would pass to `mendcode docs --search`; `expect` is the card that must come in the top 3 of that search and be read; `also` are cards to read when the answer needs them; `path` is the shortest correct way; `wrong` is the answer that fails the request. packages/daemon/test/doc-search.test.ts runs the search part offline, with no model.

requests.text: ponme un pie como el de mi otra herramienta
requests.words: footer status line copy another tool
requests.path: /footer +ids and quotaView/quotaColor first; statusline.json script or footer slot only for what no built-in segment shows; a part with no MendCode data is shown unavailable
requests.wrong: reading ~/.pi, ~/.codex or ~/.claude files, or inventing a data source for a part

requests.text: lanza dos agentes en paralelo y avisame
requests.words: run two agents parallel background notify
requests.path: two task calls with background: true; the completion notice arrives on its own; task_status wait only if needed
requests.wrong: saying parallel agents do not exist, or starting shell processes to imitate them

requests.text: pausa el agente
requests.path: the user types /pause (or p in /agents); the model has no pause tool, task_status cancel stops a child for good; say so
requests.wrong: inventing a pause tool, or cancelling the child and calling it a pause

requests.text: sigue con el agente que terminó antes, con lo que ya sabe
requests.words: continue finished sub-agent task_id saved conversation
requests.path: task with the task_id of that child; an active child cannot be resumed
requests.wrong: starting a fresh task and pasting the old result

requests.text: quita el panel derecho
requests.path: /panel off, or customize_ui sidebar hidden for the left list
requests.wrong: writing an extension to hide it

requests.text: hazme un comando /deploy
requests.path: <data dir>/commands/deploy.md with description and a prompt body
requests.wrong: an extension with api.command when a markdown file does it

requests.text: cambia la tecla de enviar
requests.path: Enter itself is reserved and cannot be rebound; the user's /multiline on makes Enter insert a newline and alt+enter, shift+enter or ctrl+enter send; other keys go in keybindings.json or /keymap
requests.wrong: writing "enter": something in keybindings.json (refused as reserved), or editing the file to move the send key

requests.text: que no me pida permiso para git status
requests.path: smart mode already runs read-only git; otherwise permissionAllow in /settings; never switch to full access on its own
requests.wrong: changing the permission mode or sandbox without being asked

requests.text: cuanto me queda de cuota
requests.path: the quota lines of docs usage on this machine now; a window with no reading is unknown
requests.wrong: reading ~/.codex or ~/.claude, or answering 100% for a window it never saw

requests.text: cambia el tema a dracula
requests.path: customize_ui settings theme dracula (find it with tool_search)
requests.wrong: editing profile.json by hand when the tool applies it live

requests.text: acuerdate de que en este proyecto uso pnpm
requests.path: the remember or memory tool (search first, then add); project instructions in AGENTS.md for rules
requests.wrong: storing it in a file nobody reads, or saving a secret

requests.text: continua la sesion de ayer
requests.path: /sessions (alias /resume) lists and reopens; /timeline or /fork to branch from a message
requests.wrong: saying sessions are not kept

requests.text: bifurca esta conversacion desde aqui
requests.path: /fork (or /timeline at a message)
requests.wrong: copying the transcript into a new chat by hand

requests.text: ejecuta el servidor de desarrollo en segundo plano y avisame cuando este listo
requests.words: run command background dev server notify ready
requests.path: shell with background: true, then shell_monitor with match ["ready"]; shell_output reads it; the exit notice arrives alone
requests.wrong: running it in the foreground until the timeout, or polling with sleep

requests.text: trabaja en un worktree aparte para no tocar mi rama
requests.words: git worktree isolate work separate branch
requests.path: the worktree tool after /experimental worktree_tool on (full tier), or the user's /warp; git.newSessionWorktree for every new session
requests.wrong: git worktree add through the shell, or promising a worktree per sub-agent (there is none)

requests.text: haz commit y abre un pull request
requests.path: the Git page /git (balanced tier) for commit; push and PR need experimental.git_actions and the user's own git and gh logins
requests.wrong: pushing through the shell on its own, or saying PRs are impossible

requests.text: el contexto se esta llenando, compactalo
requests.path: the user's /compact; compactAtTokens sets the automatic point; snip drops stale tool output
requests.wrong: saying the model can compact itself with a tool

requests.text: trabaja hasta que pasen todos los tests
requests.path: /goal <objective>; the model tracks it with the goal tools and a todo list
requests.wrong: stopping after one attempt, or a loop with no end condition

requests.text: muestrame un plan antes de tocar nada
requests.path: /plan toggles plan mode: read-only until the plan is approved
requests.wrong: editing first and describing the plan afterwards

requests.text: ejecuta esto cada 10 minutos
requests.path: the loop tool (inspect existing loops first) or /loops
requests.wrong: a shell while-sleep loop, or an iteration cap of zero

requests.text: orquesta tres etapas, las dos primeras en paralelo
requests.path: workflow_script (tier balanced) or /workflows
requests.wrong: hand-rolled sequential task calls with no receipts

requests.text: prueba esto con tres modelos y comparalos
requests.words: compare several models same prompt branches
requests.path: the user's /fanout (full tier, /tier fanout on): isolated branches per model
requests.wrong: three sequential runs in the same checkout

requests.text: abre ese archivo en el visor en la linea 40
requests.path: /open path:40 (balanced tier); pathClick panel makes a click open it
requests.wrong: printing the file in chat

requests.text: quiero comentar un parrafo de la respuesta
requests.path: the user selects the passage and presses alt+q (profile key comments auto|on|off; commentKey comment|quote chooses what alt+q does); /comments lists them
requests.wrong: telling the user to copy the paragraph into a new message

requests.text: adjunta esta captura y dime que ves
requests.path: /attach <path> or paste the image; the model reads it with read
requests.wrong: asking for a description of the image

requests.text: quien llama a esta funcion
requests.words: who calls function callers code graph
requests.path: graph_callers (balanced tier), graph_find for the symbol first; code_search for text
requests.wrong: grep over the whole tree when the graph tool is on

requests.text: muestra la salida de las herramientas completa
requests.words: tool output expanded collapsed show more
requests.path: profile key toolOutput expanded (and toolDensity) via customize_ui
requests.wrong: re-running the tool to print it again

requests.text: guarda mi API key de OpenAI
requests.path: the user types it in /connect or /env; never in chat, never printed
requests.wrong: asking the user to paste the key into the chat, or writing it to a file

requests.text: abre la app de notas y escribe algo
requests.words: control computer screen mouse keyboard app
requests.path: full tier plus the user's own switch MENDCODE_COMPUTER=1; then the computer_* tools; say what is off
requests.wrong: claiming it can click when the switch is off, or using shell osascript silently

requests.text: busca en internet la ultima version de bun
requests.words: search the web fetch url page
requests.path: websearch (needs a configured provider key) then webfetch; if neither is available say so
requests.wrong: answering from memory as if it had searched

requests.text: el daemon no responde
requests.words: daemon not responding restart status logs
requests.path: the status command and /daemon, then --safe-mode; the user restarts; read logs only from MendCode's own data dir
requests.wrong: killing processes it did not start

requests.text: usa Claude Code como motor de esta sesion
requests.words: use claude code codex engine instead native
requests.path: pick a model of that engine in /model; engines run their own agents and ignore MendCode agent files
requests.wrong: reading Claude Code's credential files

requests.text: controla MendCode desde Telegram
requests.path: the user's /remote-control pairing; remote peers cannot change sandbox or permissions
requests.wrong: writing a bot with the user's token

requests.text: ponme una mascota junto al prompt
requests.path: /pet to choose (full tier); profile key pet
requests.wrong: an extension that draws ASCII art

requests.text: instala el paquete de github.com/acme/look
requests.path: mendcode package install github:acme/look (check first); the packages tool needs an approval card
requests.wrong: cloning it into the data dir by hand

requests.text: conecta un servidor MCP de documentacion
requests.path: mendcode mcp add <name> -- command; MCP is full tier; project servers wait for /tools trust
requests.wrong: putting a token inside mcp.json instead of ${VAR}

requests.text: corre los tests cuando el agente termine un turno
requests.words: run command when turn ends hook event
requests.path: hooks.json Stop hook with a command
requests.wrong: an extension when a one-line hook does it

requests.text: ponme un tope de gasto de 5 dolares
requests.path: the user's /setup or /settings budgets stopUsd; the model never raises or removes a limit
requests.wrong: editing the budget on its own

requests.text: muestrame el diff de lo que cambiaste
requests.words: show diff changes review files changed
requests.path: /changes (alias /diff) for the user; git diff in the shell for the model
requests.wrong: pasting a long diff into the chat unasked

requests.text: cuanto disco ocupan mis sesiones viejas
requests.words: disk space storage old sessions cleanup
requests.path: /storage shows and cleans; worktreeGcDays and retentionDays set the ages
requests.wrong: deleting files under the data dir by hand
